content.text:
The drawing shows ethyl 4-(naphthalen-1-yl)-1H-pyrrole-3-carboxylate.

- **Pyrrole ring:** NH at the bottom. C2 is the CH at the lower right, next to NH. C3 is the upper right carbon and carries the ester, C(=O)OEt. C4 is the upper left carbon and carries the naphthyl group. C5 is the CH at the lower left.
- **Naphthalene:** it is attached through its 1-position. The attachment carbon is adjacent to the ring-fusion carbon, which is consistent with the drawing, where the attachment carbon sits next to the fused junction.

SMILES: CCOC(=O)c1c[nH]cc1-c1cccc2ccccc12
